final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS overall_mean FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_rate_per_day, r.avg_rate_per_day - o.overall_mean AS above_overall_mean FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.avg_rate_per_day > o.overall_mean ORDER BY r.rating
